confidence.formula: sum(weight * roleConfidence over mapped roles) / sum(weight over all 22 roles)

tokenize.stripNamespace: keep only the text after the LAST ':' and then after the LAST '|'
tokenize.splitCamelCase: split between a lowercase letter followed by an uppercase letter
tokenize.splitDigits: split wherever a digit meets a non-digit

excludedRule: a bone whose token list CONTAINS any excluded token (exact token match) is never a candidate

side.rule: exact token match; left is tested first. Sided parts (clavicle, upperarm, lowerarm, hand, thigh, calf, foot, toe) with no side are dropped. Unsided parts (pelvis, spine, neck, head) ignore side.

partRuleMatch: a rule matches if ANY of: some token in anyToken; some group in allTokensAny fully present; some token startsWith an anyTokenStartsWith prefix; OR (allTokens all present AND no noneTokens present). anyToken/allTokensAny/anyTokenStartsWith and allTokens are alternatives inside one rule.

assignment.depth: number of ancestors of the bone (root = 0)
assignment.sidedAndNeckHead: for each role, among its candidates pick the SHALLOWEST (smallest depth); ties keep the first in bone order. Role confidence = that candidate's rule conf (neck/head use 1.0).
assignment.pelvis: among pelvis candidates, pick the DEEPEST one that is an ancestor of BOTH a left-thigh candidate and a right-thigh candidate; if none qualifies, the shallowest pelvis candidate. Confidence 1.0.
assignment.spine: spine candidates that are descendants of the pelvis (if mapped) AND ancestors of the neck (or of the head if no neck), sorted by depth. n=1 -> spine_mid; n>=2 -> spine_lo = first, spine_hi = last; n>=3 also spine_mid = chain[floor(n/2)]. Confidence 1.0.
assignment.hierarchySanity: after assignment, if pelvis is mapped then thigh_l, thigh_r, head, upperarm_l, upperarm_r must each be DESCENDANTS of the pelvis; any that is not is unmapped. Then confidence is recomputed.
assignment.method: 'dictionary' if at least one role mapped, else 'none'

conventions.rule: evaluated over all lowercased bone names; first true flag in this order wins

order.test: any name contains 'upperleg' AND starts with 'left' or 'right'

conventions.informational: the convention label is metadata only; it never gates acceptance

topologyFallback.rule: used only when the dictionary result lacks a required role or has confidence < 0.80; minimum 15 bones; role confidences 0.6-0.7 and overall confidence capped at 0.80. Not exported in detail: OFF until it passes its test matrix. A web importer must treat topology-only rigs as NOT supported humanoids.

acceptance.onAccept: inherits ALL official Fermata body animations through the runtime retarget (UFermataBodyRetargetComponent); NO embedded clip required
acceptance.onReject: not a supported humanoid: the upload must bring its own embedded animation clip(s); without one it is rejected

note: Role vocabulary and naming tokens used by the importer to recognise a humanoid skeleton.
